title: Canvas Gallery

services.name: Rentals for Film & Commercial Use
services.desc: Canvas Gallery offers original Canadian art rentals for film, television, advertising, and commercial productions. Our curated collection features work by professional Canadian artists, with all artwork cleared and approved for on-screen and commercial use. We regularly work with production teams, set decorators, stylists, and creative agencies, and we are happy to sign all required release and clearance paperwork on behalf of our artists, making the rental process simple, efficient, and production-ready.
